definitions.explanation: The formal or literary reading of 一昨日, used in written language, news, and formal speech. The everyday reading is おととい.

examples.japanese: {一昨日|いっさくじつ}の{会議|かいぎ}の{議事録|ぎじろく}を{確認|かくにん}した。
examples.english: I checked the minutes from the meeting the day before yesterday.

examples.japanese: {一昨日|いっさくじつ}から{気温|きおん}が{急|きゅう}に{下|さ}がった。
examples.english: The temperature dropped suddenly starting from the day before yesterday.

examples.japanese: {一昨日|いっさくじつ}{付|づ}けの{新聞|しんぶん}に{関連|かんれん}{記事|きじ}が{掲載|けいさい}されていた。
examples.english: A related article was published in the newspaper dated the day before yesterday.

notes:
USAGE:
The formal reading いっさくじつ is used in news, official documents, and formal speech. In everyday conversation, おととい is much more common. Both readings use the same kanji 一昨日.

SIMILAR WORDS:
- おととい: the day before yesterday — the everyday reading of the same word
- {一昨年|いっさくねん}: the year before last — the same pattern applied to years
